uncited: This family covers methods that extract isosurfaces from hierarchical volume data by dynamically adjusting extraction resolution to balance computational cost and visual fidelity [S1].

It sets itself apart from fixed-resolution approaches by using frame-timing feedback to modulate detail [7457-adaptive-minimum-projected-size-adjustment.md], omitting geometric reconnection to maximize display rates [7512-non-reconnected-multiresolution-isosurfacing.md], or employing oracle-driven traversal with explicit crack patching to guarantee watertightness [11830-adaptive-multiresolution-extraction-with-oracle.md].
